title: He Sold Every Bite of Food, Then a Demon Rose Out of the Dark Roots . . . (Part 4)
caption:
Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint Part 4: Dokja Kim walks into Geumho station and turns Inho Cheon's food rules against him.
Then a tier 7 demon, the Warden of the Dark, crawls out of the roots. Follow for part 5!

#omniscientreadersviewpoint #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #fyp
comment: Would you have sold the food like Dokja, or shared it for free like Inho wanted? Why?

segments.say: Out of the black roots a hooded skeleton rises, and Dokja Kim is facing a *demon* with a homemade spear.
To see how it got here, go back to a convenience store, where Dokja is stuffing every bag he can *carry*.
The air outside is poison, so he sticks a monkey lung in his mouth and walks out like it is a *snack*.
Then a woman begs for help. She is crawling across the floor, so Dokja *carries* her out.
He sprints for Geumho station, the nearest one underground, and finds the shutter *closed*.
The survivors inside will not let in an injured woman, so Dokja rips the shutter open with his *bare hands*.
He drops her in the safety zone, hands her the monkey lung, and finally *breathes*.
Then a gang walks in that looks ordered straight from the *villain* catalogue.
Their boss, Cheolsu Bang, wants the woman. Dokja gives his name and gets *laughed* at.
Real humans are even worse than the clichés in stories. Then a bounty hunter *scenario* pops up.
Take out the grunts in five minutes. So Dokja does, and the gang goes down like *bowling pins*.
Cheolsu's gang has stats in the single digits, and Dokja's add up to thirty-three. That is not a *fight*.
Cheolsu tries to bluff about his big backer, but the Fourth Wall *blocks* it.
Then Dokja drives a blade through his hand. That was his biggest *mistake*.
Cheolsu is begging now, and Dokja asks him one thing. Why did you *do* it?
He says the apocalypse was just an excuse, and Dokja quietly admits they are not so *different*.
The timer runs out, the scenario clears, and Dokja pockets three hundred *coins*.
At the main station a woman screams his name. Sangah and Hyeonseong thought he was *dead*.
They say sorry for leaving him behind, but Dokja knows they had no choice. And Junghyeok left the station *yesterday*.
Then Mr. Han storms in with a bat and screams that Dokja is the worst of the *worst*.
A smiling man in a black turtleneck tells Han to play *nice*. Meet Inho Cheon, the leader of Geumho station.
His smile says friendly, but his eyes say *predator*. And the first thing he wants is the food.
Dokja counts eighty-six survivors, and every single one cleared the first scenario by *killing* someone.
The station is split into a Major Group that eats and a Minor Group that gets sent out to *scavenge*.
Nobody from the Minor Group ever comes back. Hyeonseong joined it anyway, because the Major Group felt *wrong*.
Inho pulls Dokja aside and offers him a high position. Dokja says *no*.
Inho laughs. He only wants the hero who saved people, so he can *use* him. Dokja saw that coming.
So Dokja hands out dinner to the Minor Group instead, and the Major Group *snaps*.
The mob wants Inho in charge of the food, and Inho smiles like a man who already *won*.
Now, Dokja, it is time to choose. Share everything for free like a hero, or hoard it like a *villain*.
Dokja picks a third option. I am no charity worker, he says, and sells the food for ten coins an *item*.
Even the constellations are relieved he is not an idiot, and drop a hundred *coins* on him.
Huiwon Jeong, the woman he saved, pays up. Then little Gilyeong pays, then everyone *pays*, and the food sells out.
The next morning the Major Group cuts rations to three biscuits a person. Funny how that *works*.
Inho thanks Dokja for the lesson in front of everyone. Nothing in this world is *free*.
Then he uses Incite, and the whole crowd turns on Dokja with *red eyes*.
Dokja does not even flinch. He sold every bite, and now he sits on one thousand four hundred and fifty *coins*.
Dokja reads Huiwon's profile and hits a jackpot. Crouching Figure, a rare attribute with Demon Slaying, and the potential to *evolve*.
She wants to stop the search party, but Dokja says the same thing happens again. The root of the problem is *food*.
And right on cue, a dokkaebi shows up. Not Bihyeong, who is being *disciplined*.
The new dokkaebi nukes the food and adds a penalty. No more stockpiling, and everything is *deleted*.
Then comes the survival fee. A hundred coins a day, or you die. Inho looks like he saw a *ghost*.
Dokja just grins. He already reads Inho's mind, and Inho is wondering if he *knew*.
Inho recovers fast and announces that anyone who will not join the search party gets *nothing*.
Dokja says no thanks, we are going monster *hunting*, and builds his own team.
The tunnels are pitch black and full of corpses. And Gilyeong, a kid, turns out to talk to *insects*.
Then a new sub scenario drops. Hunt a monster, cook it, and get five hundred *coins*.
Then the ground rats swarm in. Dokja kills four, Hyeonseong kills three, and both look like *main characters*.
But Dokja is thinking. This is exactly how the regressors felt in the novel. Lie, and *survive*.
Then a monster snatches Mr. Han and Sangah and drags them into the *dark*.
Hyeonseong screams, Gilyeong freezes, and Dokja reaches out. Except he does not *grab*.
Instead he takes Gilyeong into the Dark Fold, a place where every bit of light gets *eaten*.
Gilyeong holds his hand and asks the question. You let them go on *purpose*, didn't you?
Of course he did. The monster will lead them straight to the rat lair, and Dokja only has to *follow*.
Gilyeong asks if Dokja is a god or a protagonist. Dokja says neither. He was always *jealous* of protagonists.
Then they slide into the Ground Rats' Treasure Trove, and a glowing chest *appears*.
And who is already there? Sangah and Mr. Han, arguing about a stolen *bike*.
The world is ending, and these two are fighting over a bicycle. The apocalypse has *priorities*.
Dokja has seen enough. He swings in, smashes the rats, and the constellations toss him another hundred *coins*.
Then he whispers it. It is coming. The cave cracks, black flames burst out, and a hooded *skeleton* walks out of the roots.
The Warden of the Dark, a tier seven demon, and its aura of *fear* lands on everyone.
Han's knife is already blunt, and Gilyeong's bugs explode, so the group is *wrecked*.
Dokja's Fourth Wall eats most of the fear, and the Warden turns to *look* at him.
Dokja is alone with a tier seven demon, and it is already *moving*.
